grammar.title: There is / There are
grammar.explain_en: We use "There is" for one thing and "There are" for more than one thing.
grammar.explain_vi: Chúng ta dùng "There is" cho một thứ và "There are" cho nhiều hơn một thứ.
examples: There is a big living room.
There are two bathrooms.
There is a red sofa.
There are many chairs.

grammar.title: Prepositions of Place: in, on, under
grammar.explain_en: We use "in" for inside, "on" for on top of, and "under" for below something.
grammar.explain_vi: Chúng ta dùng "in" để chỉ bên trong, "on" để chỉ bên trên, và "under" để chỉ bên dưới.
examples: The sofa is in the living room.
The book is on the desk.
The cat is under the table.
My clothes are in the wardrobe.
grammar.right: ✅ The lamp is on the desk.
grammar.wrong: ❌ The lamp is in the desk.

grammar.title: Can / Can't
grammar.explain_en: We use "can" to say what we are able to do, and "can't" (cannot) to say what we are not able to do.
grammar.explain_vi: Chúng ta dùng "can" để nói về những gì mình có thể làm, và "can't" (cannot) để nói về những gì mình không thể làm.
examples: I can play games in the living room.
I can't play football in the kitchen.
My brother can draw on his desk.
We can't sleep in the kitchen.

grammar.title: Present Simple vs Present Continuous (actions now)
grammar.explain_en: We use Present Simple for habits. We use Present Continuous for actions happening now.
grammar.explain_vi: Chúng ta dùng Hiện tại đơn cho thói quen. Chúng ta dùng Hiện tại tiếp diễn cho hành động đang xảy ra.
examples: I often read in my bedroom. (Simple)
I am reading a book now. (Continuous)
My mom cooks in the kitchen every day. (Simple)
My mom is cooking dinner now. (Continuous)

readings.title: My Cozy Home
readings.text:
Hi! My name is Linh. I am eight years old. I live in a big house with my family. My home has got three bedrooms, two bathrooms, a living room, a kitchen, and a dining room. It also has a small garden.
My favorite room is my bedroom. It is small but very cozy. There is a bed and a small desk. I can read books on my bed. I also have a big wardrobe for my clothes.
In the living room, there is a big sofa and a TV. My family likes to watch movies there. My mom is cooking in the kitchen right now. I love my cozy home!

readings.title: A Busy Saturday at Home
readings.text:
It's Saturday morning, and everyone in Ben's home is busy! Ben is in his bedroom. He is making his bed and putting his books on the bookshelf. He can tidy his room by himself.
His little sister, Mia, is in the living room. She is playing with her toy cars on the rug. Their dad is in the kitchen. He is making breakfast for everyone. The fridge is open, and he is taking out some milk.
Their mom is in the garden. She is watering the plants and picking some flowers. Oh, wait! Now she is calling Ben and Mia for breakfast.
The dining room table is set. There are plates, forks, and spoons. Ben and Mia run to the dining room. They are hungry! What a busy and happy home.

readings.title: My Dream Home
readings.text:
Hello! My name is Tom. I am a student in Grade 3. I often think about my dream home. It is a big, modern house with many special rooms.
First, there is a super cool gaming room! It has a giant TV, two comfy sofas, and lots of video games. I can play with my friends there all day. Next to it, there is a small cinema room with big, soft chairs and a popcorn machine. We can watch all our favorite movies.
My bedroom is very big. It has a secret door to a treehouse in the garden! Inside my bedroom, there is a huge bed, a desk with two computer screens, and a robot that tidies my clothes in the wardrobe.
The kitchen is always full of delicious smells because my robot chef cooks yummy food. There is also a swimming pool in the garden, and a slide from the second floor directly into the pool! It sounds amazing, right? I hope my dream home comes true one day.

listening.script:
Hello everyone! My name is Lucy, and I want to tell you about my home. I live in a colorful house with my parents and my little brother, Tom. Our house has a living room, a kitchen, a dining room, two bedrooms, and one bathroom.
In the living room, there is a big red sofa and a TV. My family likes to play board games there on weekends. My mom cooks delicious food in the kitchen every day. There is a big fridge and a stove.
My bedroom is blue. There is a bed, a small desk, and a wardrobe. I often read books at my desk. My brother Tom's bedroom is green. He has many toys in his room.
Right now, my mom is cleaning the bathroom, and my dad is helping Tom tidy his toys in the living room. I am sitting in my bedroom and talking to you. I love my home very much!

life_skill.title: KEEP YOUR HOME CLEAN AND TIDY
life_skill.intro: Our home is a special place where we live and grow. It's important to keep it clean and tidy to make it a happy and healthy place for everyone.
life_skill.intro_vi: Ngôi nhà là một nơi đặc biệt nơi chúng ta sống và lớn lên. Điều quan trọng là giữ cho nhà cửa sạch sẽ và gọn gàng để tạo ra một nơi hạnh phúc và khỏe mạnh cho mọi người.
can_do: Put my toys away after playing.
Help my parents clean the living room.
Put my dirty clothes in the laundry basket.
Help water the plants in the garden.
Help set the table for dinner.
Turn off the lights when leaving a room.
life_skill.value_question: What is one thing you can do today to make your home cleaner and happier?

fun_facts.en: Did you know? The largest house in the world has 27 floors and over 600 rooms!
fun_facts.vi: Em có biết không? Ngôi nhà lớn nhất thế giới có 27 tầng và hơn 600 phòng!

fun_facts.en: Did you know? In some countries, people live in houses made of ice called 'igloos'.
fun_facts.vi: Em có biết không? Ở một số quốc gia, người dân sống trong những ngôi nhà làm bằng băng gọi là 'igloo'.

fun_facts.en: Did you know? The kitchen is often called the "heart of the home" because families spend a lot of time cooking and eating there.
fun_facts.vi: Em có biết không? Nhà bếp thường được gọi là "trái tim của ngôi nhà" vì các gia đình dành nhiều thời gian nấu nướng và ăn uống ở đó.

fun_facts.en: Did you know? Before beds, people used to sleep on straw mats or animal skins on the floor!
fun_facts.vi: Em có biết không? Trước khi có giường, mọi người thường ngủ trên chiếu rơm hoặc da động vật trên sàn nhà!

fun_facts.en: Did you know? Having plants in your home can make the air cleaner and make you feel happier!
fun_facts.vi: Em có biết không? Có cây xanh trong nhà có thể làm không khí trong lành hơn và khiến bạn cảm thấy vui vẻ hơn!

classroom_game.name: Room Explorer
steps_en: Each group gets a set of cards with room names (living room, kitchen, bedroom, bathroom, dining room, garden) and item names (sofa, bed, fridge, toilet, table, TV, desk, stove).
One student picks a room card without showing it.
Other students ask "Is there a... in this room?" or "What can you do in this room?".
The student with the card answers "Yes, there is." or "No, there isn't." or "You can...".
The first student to guess the room correctly wins a point.
steps_vi: Mỗi nhóm nhận một bộ thẻ gồm tên các phòng (phòng khách, nhà bếp, phòng ngủ, phòng tắm, phòng ăn, khu vườn) và tên các đồ vật (ghế sofa, giường, tủ lạnh, bồn cầu, bàn, TV, bàn học, bếp).
Một học sinh chọn một thẻ phòng mà không cho người khác thấy.
Các học sinh khác hỏi "Is there a... in this room?" (Có... trong phòng này không?) hoặc "What can you do in this room?" (Bạn có thể làm gì trong phòng này?).
Học sinh giữ thẻ trả lời "Yes, there is." (Có.) hoặc "No, there isn't." (Không có.) hoặc "You can..." (Bạn có thể...).
Học sinh đầu tiên đoán đúng tên phòng sẽ được một điểm.
